item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks foster, adoption help during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation that has affected about 67 animals on site.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County return home after nearly two years of displacement
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County are able to return home after nearly two years of being displaced from their condos due to structural damage. Some residents who cannot afford to return are filing for bankruptcy and foreclosure.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers homeowners rates 5.6% for Florida customers
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6%, the latest in a series of rate decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts finish top 15 at nationals, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer earned a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics. item.title: Argentina rallies past England with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Defending World Cup champion Argentina scored twice in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 and advance to Sunday's final against Spain.

item.title: World Cup final four set after quarterfinal matches
item.description: England, Argentina, Spain, and France advanced to the World Cup semifinals after weekend and Monday quarterfinal matches.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to local children this summer
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach supports more than 35 Summer BreakSpot sites across the county, serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children while school is out.

item.title: Security First Insurance cuts Florida homeowner rates 5.6 percent
item.description: The Ormond Beach-based insurer announced the rate reduction Thursday, the latest in a series of decreases over the last two years.
